scope: Selected previous-edition native pages 1-16, inspected at full 1024x1536 RGB dimensions. This is an immutable before-improvement baseline, not final-edition selection or acceptance.

anchors.5.0: No visible defect in that category at native size.
anchors.4.5: Polished with a small nonessential visible limitation.
anchors.4.0: Clear and complete but noticeable repairable defects.
anchors.3.0: Usable draft with substantial distracting defects.

rubric.five_point_category_scope: A 5.0 is this reviewer’s no-observed-defect category grade under the commissioned static-book rubric. It does not grant owner/runtime visual 5/5 under DL-VIS-07.
rubric.final_aggregation_not_performed: Final selection requires root and independent reviews; use the lower score in every category and then the unrounded 32-page mean. This baseline range is not that final calculation.

inspection.method: tools.view_image with detail=original on every exact selected native page; read the frozen panel staging/entries for contact and speaker ownership.
inspection.defect_region_units: Approximate descriptive pixel bounds in the full native page, not crop instructions or derived images.
inspection.distinguish_depth_softness: Deliberate softness in small nonessential distant people is allowed; it is not scored as a blur defect merely for lacking foreground-level detail.
limitations: Human-like qualitative agent assessment; no optical sharpness or child-reading test is claimed.
A partly hidden hand may belong to an off-panel supporter; unclear ownership is recorded instead of asserting an extra limb.
The page-16 tail has an ambiguous immediate landing despite a projected direction toward Roshan; wrong-speaker hard failure is not conclusively asserted.

authority.no_findings_reason: Independent static-book source review does not implement a game repair or close a canonical finding. MA-DOC-008 identity precedence and game-wide visual acceptance boundaries remain applicable context, not closure claims.
authority.impact_owner: /root covers this exact new JSON path in the task’s audit-impact record.
